name: boxfix_v1
meaning: guided filter radius r=min(12,max(1,floor(0.4*box short side))), eps 1e-4, colour guide; threshold = 0.3 * max of filtered posterior inside box clip (absolute tau 0.35 never binds); intersect box clip and box-inscribed superellipse |2dx/w|^2.5+|2dy/h|^2.5<=1; masker knobs unchanged (npz 0.3/1.6)
selection: max val mean IoU over sweeps v1-v8 (108 val tiles, 7032 valid crowns); pre-declared tie rule: prefer no fill/largest if within 0.0005 (fl variant 0.8196 vs chosen 0.8195)
